title: A rare case of SCHMID metaphyseal chondrodysplasia associated with hypothyroidism,growth hormone deficiency and celiac disease: case report.
authors: Chreitah A, Bress F, Aljanati O, Alkilany Z, Mohammed A, Kherbek F.
figures: A 4-year-2-month-old boy with short stature, bowing lower limbs, and micromelia.
Pelvis and lower limbs radiograph show bowing femurs, large capital epiphyses, and short femoral necks. Wide growth plate of tubular bones.
Showed a normal MRI of the brain and the pituitary gland.
tables: Parathyroid hormone and glycated haemoglobin results.
